name: THE MOURNERS
note: THE MOURNERS AT THE GATE (doc 110 section 2: "Half the town, in black, at the gate"), while the procession is stalled (errata 233). Room 31's seven (funeral_mourners' sheet), drawn by figureHeight 350 -- Room 31's man where they stand there (y 664) -- so they are Room 14's size here. While the prayer runs they bow their heads and shut their eyes (spriteWhen; operation 2's sheet). Examined through THE MOURNERS.

spriteWhen.note: Doc 110 section 2, TALK TO REVEREND SOWERBY: "The mourners bow their heads and shut their eyes." While the prayer runs they are bowed, eyes shut (reference/act3-hearse/handback.md, operation 2), and now and then the young man in spectacles at the right peeks. Registered on the group's legs to their rest frame, so the group does not shift (errata 233).
